item.title: Video, the Last Frontier of Conversation
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Video, the Last Frontier of Conversation If AI can already read and speak, why aren’t artificial agents routinely serving customers by video? It isn’t a camera problem. Nor a bandwidth problem. AI can already see. The hard part is holding a visual conversation in real time, understanding the context and responding the way a human interaction demands. There are three reasons. 1. Seeing is not the same as understanding An LLM processes text extraordinarily well.
